oig: OIG is the investigative arm of the Federal Trade Commission.
OIG means the same as Office of Inspector General.
oil: An oil is a slippery or viscous liquid or liquefiable substance not miscible with water.
Oil can also mean oil paint containing pigment that is used by an artist.
Oil can also mean cover with oil, as if by rubbing.
Oil means the same as oil color or oil colour.
oil-hardened steel: Oil-hardened steel is steel that is quenched in oil.
oil-industry analyst: An oil-industry analyst is an analyst of the oil industry.
oil-rich seed: An oil-rich seed is any of several seeds that yield oil.
Oil-rich seed means the same as oilseed.
oil-water interface: An oil-water interface is an interface forming the boundary between the non-miscible liquids oil and water.
oil beetle: An oil beetle is any of various beetles that exude an oily substance from the leg joints that deters enemies.
oil burner: An oil burner is a furnace that burns oil.
Oil burner means the same as oil furnace.
oil business: An oil business is an industry that produces and delivers oil and oil products.
Oil business means the same as oil industry or refining industry.
oil cake: Oil cake is mass of e.g. linseed or cottonseed or soybean from which the oil has been pressed.
oil cartel: An oil cartel is a cartel of companies or nations formed to control the production and distribution of oil.
oil change: Oil change is replacing dirty oil with clean.
oil color: Oil color is oil paint containing pigment that is used by an artist.
Oil color means the same as oil or oil colour.
oil colour: Oil colour is oil paint containing pigment that is used by an artist.
Oil colour means the same as oil or oil color.
oil company: An oil company is a company that sells oil.
oil conservation: An oil conservation is the conservation of petroleum resources.
oil filter: An oil filter is a filter that removes impurities from the oil used to lubricate an internal-combustion engine.
oil furnace: An oil furnace is a furnace that burns oil.
Oil furnace means the same as oil burner.
oil future: Oil future is petroleum bought or sold at an agreed price for delivery at a specified future date.
Oil future means the same as petroleum future.
oil geologist: An oil geologist is a specialist in petroleum geology.
Oil geologist means the same as petroleum geologist.
oil gland: An oil gland is a gland that secretes oil.
oil heater: Oil heater is heater that burns oil for heating or cooking.
Oil heater means the same as oilstove or kerosene heater or kerosine heater.
oil industry: An oil industry is an industry that produces and delivers oil and oil products.
Oil industry means the same as refining industry or oil business.
oil lamp: An oil lamp is a lamp that burns oil for light.
Oil lamp means the same as kerosene lamp or kerosine lamp.
oil meal: Oil meal is ground oil cake.
oil nut: Oil nut is oily drupaceous fruit of rabbitwood.
Oil nut means the same as buffalo nut or elk nut.
oil of cloves: Oil of cloves is essential oil obtained from cloves and used to flavor medicines.
Oil of cloves means the same as clove oil.
oil of turpentine: Oil of turpentine is volatile liquid distilled from turpentine oleoresin.
Oil of turpentine means the same as turpentine or spirit of turpentine or turps.
oil of vitriol: Oil of vitriol is a highly corrosive acid made from sulfur dioxide.
Oil of vitriol means the same as vitriol or sulfuric acid or sulphuric acid.
oil of wintergreen: Oil of wintergreen is oil or flavoring obtained from the creeping wintergreen or teaberry plant.
Oil of wintergreen means the same as wintergreen oil.
oil paint: Oil paint is paint in which a drying oil is the vehicle.
oil painter: An oil painter is a painter who uses oil paints.
oil painting: An oil painting is a picture painted with oil paints.
Oil painting can also mean the art or method of painting with oil paints.
oil palm: Oil palm is pinnate-leaved palms of the genus Elaeis having dense clusters of crowded flowers and bright red fruit and yielding high quality palm oils.
oil pipeline: An oil pipeline is a pipeline used to transport oil.
oil pressure: Oil pressure is pressure that keeps oil on the moving parts of an internal-combustion engine.
oil production: An oil production is the act of drilling a hole in the earth in the hope of producing petroleum.
Oil production means the same as boring or drilling.
oil pump: An oil pump is a pump that keeps a supply of oil on moving parts.
oil refinery: An oil refinery is a refinery for petroleum.
Oil refinery means the same as petroleum refinery.
oil rig: Oil rig is rig used in drilling for oil or gas.
Oil rig means the same as drill rig or drilling rig or oilrig.
oil rigger: An oil rigger is someone who works on an oil rig.
Oil rigger means the same as rigger.
oil shale: Oil shale is shale from which oil can be obtained by heating.
oil slick: An oil slick is a thin film of oil floating on top of water.
oil stain: An oil stain is a stain produced by oil.
oil tanker: An oil tanker is a cargo ship designed to carry crude oil in bulk.
Oil tanker means the same as oiler or tanker or tank ship.
oil tycoon: An oil tycoon is a powerful person in the oil business.
oil well: An oil well is a well that yields or has yielded oil.
Oil well means the same as oiler.
oilbird: Oilbird is nocturnal fruit-eating bird of South America that has fatty young yielding an oil that is used instead of butter.
Oilbird means the same as guacharo or Steatornis caripensis.
oilcan: An oilcan is a can with a long nozzle to apply oil to machinery.
oilcloth: Oilcloth is cloth treated on one side with a drying oil or synthetic resin.
oiler: An oiler is a worker who oils engines or machinery.
Oiler can also mean a well that yields or has yielded oil.
Oiler can also mean a cargo ship designed to carry crude oil in bulk.
Oiler means the same as oil well or oil tanker or tanker.
oilfield: An oilfield is a region rich in petroleum deposits.
oilfish: Oilfish is very large deep-water snake mackerel.
Oilfish means the same as Ruvettus pretiosus.
oiliness: Oiliness is consisting of or covered with oil.
Oiliness can also mean smug self-serving earnestness.
Oiliness means the same as greasiness or oleaginousness or fulsomeness.
oilman: An oilman is a person who owns or operates oil wells.
Oilman can also mean a worker who produces or sells petroleum.
oilpaper: Oilpaper is paper that has been made translucent and waterproof by soaking in oil.
oilrig: Oilrig is rig used in drilling for oil or gas.
Oilrig means the same as drill rig or drilling rig or oil rig.
oilseed: An oilseed is any of several seeds that yield oil.
Oilseed means the same as oil-rich seed.
oilskin: An oilskin is a macintosh made from cotton fabric treated with oil and pigment to make it waterproof.
Oilskin means the same as slicker.
oilstone: An oilstone is a whetstone for use with oil.
oilstove: Oilstove is heater that burns oil for heating or cooking.
Oilstove means the same as oil heater or kerosene heater or kerosine heater.
oink: An oink is the short low gruff noise of the kind made by hogs.
Oink can also mean utter a high-pitched cry, characteristic of pigs.
Oink means the same as grunt or squeal.
ointment: Ointment is semisolid preparation applied externally as a remedy or for soothing an irritation.
Ointment can also mean toiletry consisting of any of various substances in the form of a thick liquid that have a soothing and moisturizing effect when applied to the skin.
Ointment means the same as unction or unguent or balm.
oireachtas: Oireachtas is the parliament of the Irish Republic.
ois: OIS is agency that oversees the intelligence relationships of the Treasury's offices and bureaus and provides a link between the Intelligence Community and officials responsible for international economic policy.
OIS means the same as Office of Intelligence Support.
oil-fired: Oil-fired means fueled by burning oil.
oily: Oily means containing an unusual amount of grease or oil.
Oily can also mean unpleasantly and excessively suave or ingratiating in manner or speech.
Oily can also mean coated or covered with oil.
Oily means the same as greasy or sebaceous or oleaginous.
